parameters.name: FirmwareDesc
parameters.description: The description of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The ID is the unique identity of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

The over-the-air update upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke the [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) operation to create an over-the-air update upgrade package.

You can also invoke the [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) operation to view the ID in the response.

parameters.name: FirmwareName
parameters.description: The name of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The name must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and parentheses (()). The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, Japanese character, or digit. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length.

parameters.name: FirmwareUdi
parameters.description: The custom information to be pushed to the device. The text content format is not limited. The information can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs.
